verses.greek: Ὁ πρεσβύτερος Γαΐῳ τῷ ἀγαπητῷ, ὃν ἐγὼ ἀγαπῶ ἐν ἀληθείᾳ.
verses.literal: The elder To Gaius the beloved whom I myself love in truth.
verses.dgt: The elder to Gaius, the beloved, whom I love in truth.

verses.greek: Ἀγαπητέ, περὶ πάντων εὔχομαί σε εὐοδοῦσθαι καὶ ὑγιαίνειν, καθὼς εὐοδοῦταί σου ἡ ψυχή.
verses.literal: Beloved concerning all things I pray you to do well and to be in good health even as does well your the soul.
verses.dgt: Beloved, I pray concerning all things that you prosper and be healthy, as your soul prospers.

verses.greek: ἐχάρην γὰρ λίαν ἐρχομένων ἀδελφῶν καὶ μαρτυρούντων σου τῇ ἀληθείᾳ, καθὼς σὺ ἐν ἀληθείᾳ περιπατεῖς.
verses.literal: I rejoiced for exceedingly when were coming the brothers and those bearing witness from you to the to truth even as you yourself in truth are walking.
verses.dgt: For I rejoiced greatly when brothers came, testifying to your truth, as you walk in truth.

verses.greek: μειζοτέραν τούτων οὐκ ἔχω χαράν, ἵνα ἀκούω τὰ ἐμὰ τέκνα ἐν τῇ ἀληθείᾳ περιπατοῦντα.
verses.literal: Greater than these things not I have joy that I may hear of the my children in the truth walking.
verses.dgt: I have no greater joy than these things: hearing my children walk in truth.

verses.greek: Ἀγαπητέ, πιστὸν ποιεῖς ὃ ἐὰν ἐργάσῃ εἰς τοὺς ἀδελφοὺς καὶ τοῦτο ξένους,
verses.literal: Beloved faithfully you are doing whatever maybe you shall do for the brothers and that thing strangers
verses.dgt: Beloved, you do faithfully whatever you work for the brothers, and this for strangers,

verses.greek: οἳ ἐμαρτύρησάν σου τῇ ἀγάπῃ ἐνώπιον ἐκκλησίας, οὓς καλῶς ποιήσεις προπέμψας ἀξίως τοῦ θεοῦ·
verses.literal: who testified of your the love before the church whom well you will do having set forward worthily the of God.
verses.dgt: They testified to your love before the church. You will do well sending them forward worthily of God.

verses.greek: ὑπὲρ γὰρ τοῦ ὀνόματος ἐξῆλθον μηδὲν λαμβάνοντες ἀπὸ τῶν ἐθνικῶν.
verses.literal: On behalf for of the name they went forth nothing accepting from the Gentile people.
verses.dgt: For on behalf of the Name they went out, receiving nothing from the Gentiles.

verses.greek: ἡμεῖς οὖν ὀφείλομεν ὑπολαμβάνειν τοὺς τοιούτους, ἵνα συνεργοὶ γινώμεθα τῇ ἀληθείᾳ.
verses.literal: We ourselves therefore ought to receive the such men so that fellow workers we may be in the truth.
verses.dgt: Therefore we ought to receive such people and become fellow workers with the truth.

verses.greek: Ἔγραψά τι τῇ ἐκκλησίᾳ· ἀλλʼ ὁ φιλοπρωτεύων αὐτῶν Διοτρέφης οὐκ ἐπιδέχεται ἡμᾶς.
verses.literal: I have written something to the church but the one loving to be first among them Diotrephes not welcomes us.
verses.dgt: I wrote something to the church, but Diotrephes, who loves to be first among them, does not receive us.

verses.greek: διὰ τοῦτο, ἐὰν ἔλθω, ὑπομνήσω αὐτοῦ τὰ ἔργα ἃ ποιεῖ, λόγοις πονηροῖς φλυαρῶν ἡμᾶς, καὶ μὴ ἀρκούμενος ἐπὶ τούτοις οὔτε αὐτὸς ἐπιδέχεται τοὺς ἀδελφοὺς καὶ τοὺς βουλομένους κωλύει καὶ ἐκ τῆς ἐκκλησίας ἐκβάλλει.
verses.literal: Because of this if I shall come I will bring to remembrance of him the works which he is doing with words evil prating against us and not being satisfied with these neither himself he receives the brothers and those purposing he forbids and from the church he casts them out.
verses.dgt: Therefore, if I come, I will call to mind his works that he does, babbling against us with evil words. And not being satisfied with these things, he himself does not receive the brothers; he also prevents those who want to and casts them out of the church.

verses.greek: Ἀγαπητέ, μὴ μιμοῦ τὸ κακὸν ἀλλὰ τὸ ἀγαθόν. ὁ ἀγαθοποιῶν ἐκ τοῦ θεοῦ ἐστιν· ὁ κακοποιῶν οὐχ ἑώρακεν τὸν θεόν.
verses.literal: Beloved not do imitate what is evil but what is good. The one doing good of the God is the one doing evil not has seen the God.
verses.dgt: Beloved, do not imitate evil but good. The one who does good is from God; the one who does evil has not seen God.

verses.greek: Δημητρίῳ μεμαρτύρηται ὑπὸ πάντων καὶ ὑπὸ αὐτῆς τῆς ἀληθείας· καὶ ἡμεῖς δὲ μαρτυροῦμεν, καὶ οἶδας ὅτι ἡ μαρτυρία ἡμῶν ἀληθής ἐστιν.
verses.literal: To Demetrius witness has been given by all and by itself the truth and we ourselves also bear witness and you know that the testimony of us true is.
verses.dgt: Demetrius is testified to by everyone and by the truth itself. We also testify, and you know our testimony is true.

verses.greek: Πολλὰ εἶχον γράψαι σοι, ἀλλʼ οὐ θέλω διὰ μέλανος καὶ καλάμου σοι γράφειν·
verses.literal: Many things I had to write to you but not I desire with ink and pen to you to write
verses.dgt: I had many things to write, but I do not want to write through ink and pen.

verses.greek: ἐλπίζω δὲ εὐθέως σε ἰδεῖν, καὶ στόμα πρὸς στόμα λαλήσομεν.
verses.literal: I hope however soon you to see and mouth to mouth we will speak.
verses.dgt: But I hope to see you immediately, and we will speak face to face.

verses.greek: Εἰρήνη σοι. ἀσπάζονταί σε οἱ φίλοι. ἀσπάζου τοὺς φίλους κατʼ ὄνομα.
verses.literal: Peace to you. Greet you the friends. do greet the friends by name.
verses.dgt: Peace to you. The friends greet you. Greet the friends by name.
